recordFields.credentialId: string: stable opaque ID, unique within installation and host
recordFields.generation: integer >= 1: replacement sequence, never derived from secret bytes
recordFields.hostId: string: enrolled host or control-plane owner; templates must be marked
recordFields.accountRef: string|null: non-secret account alias, not a bearer
recordFields.scopes: string[]: exact repositories, role grants or peer routes
recordFields.consumers: string[]: service/role identities; aliases are consumers, not credentials
recordFields.ownerRole: string: required custodian role until ownerRef resolved
recordFields.localLocator: string|null: host-only location without credential values
recordFields.secretRef: string|null: local resolver handle, never dereferenceable by Studio
recordFields.issuerCredentialRef: credentialId|null: issuer dependency, especially GitHub registration
recordFields.createdAt: UTC timestamp|null: issuer or creation receipt only
recordFields.discoveredAt: UTC timestamp|null: actual host discovery, not document authorship
recordFields.lastVerifiedAt: UTC timestamp|null: real operation succeeded with this generation
recordFields.expiresAt: UTC timestamp|null: hard credential/session deadline, not access-token refresh time
recordFields.accessTokenExpiresAt: UTC timestamp|null: CLI refresh hint only
recordFields.rotationDueAt: UTC timestamp|null: separately labelled local policy date
recordFields.runbookId: string|null: incident or routine procedure ID
recordFields.adoptedGenerationByConsumer: map<string,integer>: effective adoption, not file installation
recordFields.provenance: object: class, source, asOf; separates report from live verification
recordFields.installationId: string: authoritative installation ID; never copied to a second authority

invariants: No secret values, raw auth output, browser URL/code or credential-bearing remote URLs in registry or artifacts.
Unknown timestamps remain null; reported dates and file mtime do not become createdAt or lastVerifiedAt.
A secret generation is adopted per consumer, not merely written to disk.
Provider incident and credential state are separate dimensions.
Access-token expiry is separate from human renewal deadline.
Shadowed credential files cannot set effective-source health.
Issuer credential lineage is recorded before rotation/revocation.
Records marked template are not live host inventory.

supplementalRenewalProcedures.human: Issue a scoped replacement if issuer has no delegated issuance API. Preserve billing/account selection.
platform: Stage through protected stdin or local store adapter.
Verify exact API or repository operations without logging token.
Switch consumers; require adoption and one real operation.
Revoke old only after issuer-compatible overlap and dependency checks.
supplementalRenewalProcedures.failure: Retain valid old generation; if revocation already occurred, park only affected scope and request issuer recovery.

supplementalRenewalProcedures.human: Reauthorise the issuer application in its official browser flow.
platform: Record permissions and registered deploy-key dependencies.
Verify replacement can perform the narrowly required registration operation.
Re-register dependent keys under approved independent issuer before revoking an OAuth token that would delete them.
supplementalRenewalProcedures.failure: Do not revoke registration credential while dependent repository access is unproved.

supplementalRenewalProcedures.human: Installation administrator authorises host identity and existing project grants.
platform: Use owning backend enrolment API, not standalone principal endpoints by assumption.
Stage host token file; verify fresh authenticated capability and lease traffic.
Use proven overlap; otherwise drain new claims and use bounded maintenance.
supplementalRenewalProcedures.failure: Recover via independently authenticated management route; never grant broader projects to bypass failed enrolment.

supplementalRenewalProcedures.human: Host administrator authorises target and pinned host identity.
platform: Generate private key in controller store.
Add new public key with existing restrictions.
Open fresh host-key-verified connection.
Switch identity, wait for adoption, remove old public key.
supplementalRenewalProcedures.failure: Keep old management access until new session proof; independently verify any host-key change.

supplementalRenewalProcedures.human: Domain or private-CA owner authorises initial issuance or changed trust.
platform: Use configured issuer renewal path; private key stays with TLS terminator.
Stage certificate and chain; validate name, chain and issuer expiry.
Reload edge gracefully and verify real TLS plus authenticated Task Server request from runner.
Retain prior valid material through bounded rollback window.
supplementalRenewalProcedures.failure: Restore previous valid certificate; do not disable TLS verification.

supplementalRenewalProcedures.human: Storage administrator issues scoped replacement unless delegated issuer is configured.
platform: Stage protected archive credential JSON file without output capture.
Verify write, read and delete on a dedicated canary object under permitted prefix.
Replace mounted secret and restart/reload archive consumer as required.
Prove backup/archive receipt, then revoke previous key.
supplementalRenewalProcedures.failure: Preserve old valid key; surface archive connectivity/access separately from provider login.

policyDefaults.unknownExpiryAction: One metadata-completion item; never invent expiry.
policyDefaults.missedThresholds: Emit highest applicable urgency once; retain missed thresholds in same receipt.

probeObservationContract.privacy: Never include raw token, browser code, full response body or credential-bearing URL.
